body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
下面图中MagicValue是个int32_t类型的参数，当整网运行dispatch和combine算子累积超INT32_MAX次后，会发生整数翻转，导致算子后续会提前退出，整网大模型会出现胡言乱语的现象。
![{3616C07B-C6C0-462E-B3E9-D31AB94FE0CC}.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/e5778834-d739-450e-b499-87737663642b/_3616C07B-C6C0-462E-B3E9-D31AB94FE0CC_.png '{3616C07B-C6C0-462E-B3E9-D31AB94FE0CC}.png')
![{5B4EA681-78F9-42AF-B490-85A6E0EC97D2}.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/1d63bcba-88de-416f-a33e-32ed41902826/_5B4EA681-78F9-42AF-B490-85A6E0EC97D2_.png '{5B4EA681-78F9-42AF-B490-85A6E0EC97D2}.png')
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
昇腾硬件型号：910B
软件环境：目前主线包环境
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
该缺陷正常复现太难，需要INT32MAX次，累积需要连续几天测试才能复现，可通过给MagicValue初始值设置为接近INT32_MAX。
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
修改改缺陷，维持设备停止工作前，算子输出无误。
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
报错情况。
![{5CD56A20-03FB-4C46-BF17-91B90B69A304}.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/95d351fd-8819-40db-9222-9f1d2f8fb086/_5CD56A20-03FB-4C46-BF17-91B90B69A304_.png '{5CD56A20-03FB-4C46-BF17-91B90B69A304}.png')
### Special notes for this issue/备注 (Optional / 选填)
